_comment: Multi-step verification policy for an envelope signed by AWS KMS. Functionary keyed by the KMS URL; pub key fetched once via aws kms get-public-key. Real signing requires kms:Sign IAM grant. CloudTrail records every Sign call for audit.
name: aws-kms-validation-v1

awskms:///alias/cilock-validation-signer._comment: AWS KMS key alias/cilock-validation-signer (RSA_2048) in testifysec-demo us-east-1. Public PEM fetched via aws kms get-public-key.

kms-demo._comment_step: Demo step. Functionary is the KMS key; anyone with kms:Sign on this key can produce a satisfying envelope. CloudTrail correlation is the out-of-band audit layer.
kms-demo.name: kms-demo

functionaries._comment_functionary: AWS KMS-backed functionary. Replace with your own key URL + PEM. In production also enforce CloudTrail correlation.
